selection_note: Third distinct five-record cohort from included canonical Index S1=A assessments all reviewed on 2026-10-22; prioritize runnable first-party Python/TypeScript source and explicitly include Swift last as a screening-only question. These are investigative questions, not admitted defects or approved fixes.

candidates.finding: The first-party Python session stack persists JSONL turns and restores a project coding session; inspect interrupted append/resume behavior using a native fixed-input Python test without provider calls.
The TypeScript CLI protects edits with freshness checks and explicit permission rules; inspect error/denial semantics under fixed source-script tests before selecting any regression.
The distributed base3 TypeScript CLI feeds first-party tool results into its step runtime; inspect native fixed-input failure propagation without invoking any hosted model.

The first-party TypeScript subagent task executor creates distinct implementer worktrees; inspect worktree cleanup and error-path reporting through native deterministic scripts, with no agent inference.
candidates.blocker: Native focused Vitest could not collect any tests: workspace package caveman-agent lacks built entry; AGENTS.md prohibits npm run build, and no external code changes were made.

candidates.finding: The optional supervised macOS Swift daemon reuses one coding loop on task branches; screen deterministic idle/cancel/branch restore paths before treating a source observation as a functional bug.
candidates.blocker: No first-party Swift/macOS daemon script test was possible in the current environment; source suggests branch restore gap but does not prove runtime impact.
